description: Make a posting group (name and account_ids), or change one (group_id, with a new name, new account_ids, or both). Changes save at once, as the app's Settings › Posting groups does when an account is ticked. Up to 20 groups of up to 30 accounts; names are unique in a workspace.

account_ids.description: The accounts in the group (accounts_list), replacing the old list

group_id.description: The group to change; left out makes a new one

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: account_group_save
title: Save a posting group
